description: Implementation of the Loan Scheme to Develop Young Entrepreneurs in the Agricultural and Industrial Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the Government’s policy statement, the Government should take steps to provide financial support and guidance to create 50,000 entrepreneurs within five years. Accordingly, as one step towards achieving that goal Rs.500 million was allocated to implement a concessional loan scheme, through a budget proposal of 2025. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2025-08-18 to utilize the said amount for the implementation of the Loan Scheme to Develop Young Entrepreneurs in the Agricultural and Industrial Sector. Provisions of Rs.750 million have been allocated in the budget for the year 2026 to further implement the said loan scheme. Accordingly, the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation submitted the measures planned by his Ministry to implement the said loan scheme through the People's Bank, the Bank of Ceylon and the Regional Development Bank at an annual interest rate of 4% and to issue relevant guidelines, to the attention of the Cabinet and the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the same.
